# Compute playlist candidates that have all their songs downloaded and total downloaded duration >= 1800 seconds
all_downloaded_ids = set(all_downloaded.keys())

candidates=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids', [])
    total_songs = len(song_ids)
    downloaded_song_ids = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid in all_downloaded_ids]
    downloaded_count = len(downloaded_song_ids)
    total_downloaded_duration = sum(all_downloaded[sid]['duration'] for sid in downloaded_song_ids)
    # also compute total duration if all songs downloaded
    total_duration_all_songs = None
    if downloaded_count==total_songs and total_songs>0:
        total_duration_all_songs = total_downloaded_duration
    candidates.append({
        'playlist_id': p['playlist_id'],
        'title': p['title'],
        'total_songs': total_songs,
        'downloaded_count': downloaded_count,
        'downloaded_duration_sec': total_downloaded_duration,
        'is_fully_downloaded': downloaded_count==total_songs and total_songs>0,
        'total_duration_sec': total_duration_all_songs
    })

# filter fully downloaded and duration >= 1800
qual=[c for c in candidates if c['is_fully_downloaded'] and (c['total_duration_sec'] is not None) and c['total_duration_sec']>=1800]
print('total_playlists', len(candidates))
print('fully_downloaded >=30min candidates', len(qual))
print('candidates_summary (all):')
for c in sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x['downloaded_duration_sec'], reverse=True):
    print(c['playlist_id'], c['title'], 'songs', c['total_songs'], 'downloaded', c['downloaded_count'], 'dur', c['downloaded_duration_sec'], 'full', c['is_fully_downloaded'])
print('qualified:')
for c in sorted(qual, key=lambda x: x['total_duration_sec']-1800):
    print('->', c['playlist_id'], c['title'], 'dur', c['total_duration_sec'], 'over', c['total_duration_sec']-1800)

# Compute per-playlist selection of downloaded songs in playlist order until reach >=1800 sec
walk_sec = 1800
best=None
results=[]
all_downloaded = globals().get('all_downloaded', {})
all_playlists = globals().get('all_playlists', [])

for p in all_playlists:
    song_ids = p.get('song_ids', [])
    selected=[]
    total=0
    skipped=[]
    for sid in song_ids:
        if sid in all_downloaded:
            selected.append(sid)
            total += all_downloaded[sid]['duration']
            if total >= walk_sec:
                break
        else:
            skipped.append(sid)
    results.append({
        'playlist_id': p['playlist_id'],
        'title': p['title'],
        'playlist_song_count': len(song_ids),
        'downloaded_available_count': sum(1 for sid in song_ids if sid in all_downloaded),
        'selected_count_until_walk': len(selected),
        'selected_duration_sec': total,
        'can_cover_30min': total>=walk_sec,
        'skipped_count_before_break': len(skipped)
    })
    if total>=walk_sec:
        if best is None or total < best['selected_duration_sec'] or (total==best['selected_duration_sec'] and len(selected) < best['selected_count_until_walk']):
            best = {
                'playlist_id': p['playlist_id'],
                'title': p['title'],
                'selected_song_ids': selected,
                'selected_duration_sec': total,
                'selected_count_until_walk': len(selected)
            }

print('playlists:', len(all_playlists))
for r in results:
    print(r)
print('best', best)

# Play selected downloaded songs from the chosen playlist without repeating
selected_song_ids = best['selected_song_ids']
print('selected_song_ids', selected_song_ids)
first_sid = selected_song_ids[0]
rest_sids = selected_song_ids[1:]

play_resp = apis.spotify.play_music(access_token=spotify_token, song_id=first_sid)
print('play_resp', play_resp)

# add remaining songs to queue in playlist order
for sid in rest_sids:
    r = apis.spotify.add_to_queue(access_token=spotify_token, song_id=sid)
    print('added', sid, r)

queue_resp = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=spotify_token)
current_resp = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=spotify_token)
print('current_song', current_resp)
print('queue_len', len(queue_resp))
# sort queue by position if present
queue_sorted = sorted(queue_resp, key=lambda x: x.get('position', 0))
queue_ids = [x['song_id'] for x in queue_sorted]
queue_durations = [x.get('duration') for x in queue_sorted]
print('queue_ids', queue_ids)
print('queue_durations', queue_durations)
# sum only if duration exists
queue_total_dur = sum(d for d in queue_durations if isinstance(d,(int,float)))
print('queue_total_duration_sec', queue_total_dur)
print('expected_selected_song_ids', best['selected_song_ids'])
print('match_expected_set', set(queue_ids)==set(best['selected_song_ids']), 'match_expected_order', queue_ids==best['selected_song_ids'])

success = (set(queue_ids)==set(best['selected_song_ids']) and queue_total_dur>=1800)
print('success_criteria_met', success)
if success:
    done = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
    print('complete_task', done)
else:
    print('Not completing task; criteria not met')
